# ANALYSIS: Evaluation of WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE for 1DTE and 2DTE weekly options

## Mechanism
We tested the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE structural DTE finding by simulating 1DTE and 2DTE weekly options (same strike ITM-2, same exit -8%/+30%) with position sizing scaled to maintain at least 3 contracts per trade (adjusting quantity if premium exceeded a threshold, though the threshold was not specified in the Stage-1 run and we used the engine's default sizing). The signal used is the same as the baseline BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup.
